sources.snippet: Inkling-Small is shown with a solid purple line, Inkling with the heavier cobalt line, and the comparison models with dashed lines. Evaluations without a reported model score are plotted at zero. Hover an evaluation to compare every model's score.

sources.title: Inkling Small · Models · Pi
sources.snippet: A terminal-based coding agent The first request starts cold unless marked otherwise. Output is billed separately from context growth because reasoning tokens are not always retained. This remains a directional estimate: providers differ in eligibility, rounding, and retention.
